body:
This makes sense to me.

It's unfortunate that it requires so many changes in so many places, but I personally think changing Godot to match the external API in this case, is the right way to make Godot and godot-cpp's APIs compatible.

There are some conflicts and this will need a rebase to merge, but you don't necessarily need to rush to rebase it now. A PR this big will likely get lots of conflicts, so it might be worth building a consensus first before rebasing too frequently.
